name: Athens International Airport

curfew.v: No curfew; the airport operates 24 hours (operator's statement, December 2024).

handling.v: The airport company awards and supervises ground handling and does not run it itself; its page lists the handling companies, without saying which serve business aviation.
handling.quote: Athens International Airport (AIA) is responsible for the award and supervision of Ground Handling services.

notes: No official source could be read. The HASP eAIP site (aisgr.hasp.gov.gr) puts the AIP behind a 'user check' page and no LGAV AD 2 file URL could be found by search (only LGMT files of the AIRAC 05/26 edition, effective 11 Jun 2026, showed up). The HCAA copy at ypa.gr (AD 2 LGAV, page date 23 Feb 2023) loops between https and http and could not be opened, and is old anyway. aia.gr search found no business-aviation, slot or night-rule page. The shared web-search budget ran out before more tries. | 2026-10-31 run: still unavailable. No HASP eAIP AD 2 LGAV URL found by search; aia.gr search found no GA/business-aviation rules page (an AIA 'GABA Rules Ed5.6' PDF exists only on a third-party blog, not used). | 2026-11-03 run: curfew and hours come from a December 2024 investor presentation, not the AIP, so check them against AD 2 LGAV. Current AIP is AMDT 09/26 (effective 29 OCT 2026), only as a multi-part ZIP (https://aisgr.hasp.gov.gr/iso-cell2), and the guessed AD 2 LGAV PDF was refused; AIP SUP 01/22 on GA/BA slots expired 30 SEP 2022 and does not list LGAV, so no slot rule.
